title: Proof of Heavenly Fate
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's voice was like a whisper from the abyss: "Three days. Enough for you to weigh the pros and cons, and enough for me to make other arrangements." Chen Ji gripped the blood-stained Jade Pendant, his knuckles turning white—after three days, his father's life intelligence would no longer be his bargaining chip, but everyone's gossip.

text.content: Ye Qing's words exploded like thunder beside his ear, freezing Chen Ji in place. For twenty years, countless nights he had dreamed of his father's blurry silhouette, waking to cold, empty pillows. Yet a single "he is still alive" made even breathing feel impossible. "Show me." His voice was hoarse, unrecognizable to himself, his outstretched fingers trembling slightly.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing placed the blood-stained Jade Pendant into his palm, its jade quality cold yet seemingly carrying his father's final warmth. "Mo Xiansheng asked me to pass this to you. He said... once you read the second page, you'll understand." She stepped back, granting him a moment of solitude.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath and opened the second page of the Tianji Record. The ink seemed to writhe like a living thing, and a yellowed letter materialized from the Void, its edges bearing scorch marks as if rescued from flames. The familiar handwriting stabbed into his eyes—those were the precise strokes his father had repeatedly corrected when teaching him to write. The four characters "For Ji'er" made his eyes instantly redden.

dialogue.content: (Trembling as he unfolded the letter) "Father's tearful words: Twenty years ago, I feigned death to protect you and escaped. Now trapped in the third level of Kunlun Ruins, only you can unlock the Heavenly Fate Key's power. Remember—do not trust any guidance from the Tianji Record, it is not my possession." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his fingertips digging into the paper's edge.

text.content: At the letter's end, a crimson Bloodline Seal glowed brilliantly. This was the unique blood authentication technique of the Chen family, formed only through the essence blood of direct blood relatives. Chen Ji bit his fingertip, letting a drop of blood fall onto the seal—immediately, a brilliant red light erupted, the seal absorbing the blood like parched earth receiving rain, then transforming into a warm current flowing into his body.

In that moment of blood resonance, an elderly and familiar voice echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "You've finally seen it." Mo Xiansheng's aura materialized like a ghost, as if he had been waiting for this moment. "The evidence is solid, your father Chen Tianming is indeed alive. But the price of living is often more cruel than death."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly formed from the first page of the Tianji Record, a hunched silhouette shrouded in gray mist. "This old man has waited too long for this day. You've read the letter, the bloodline seal has proven its authenticity. Now, it's time to discuss terms." His tone was calm as water, yet concealed hidden sharpness.

Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his churning emotions, his voice cold enough to freeze: "Speak." A single word landed, resonating with weight. Twenty years of endurance had taught him to maintain the clearest mind in the angriest moments—anger is a luxury for the weak, and he never intended to be weak.

"In three months, the seven righteous sects will meet at the East Sea to discuss a major campaign against the Demonic Path." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of playfulness, "At that grand gathering, I want you to publicly announce your departure from the Tianqing Sect and... openly form an alliance with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path." His words fell, and Chen Ji's blood nearly froze.

text.content: Publicly betraying the righteous path and allying with the Demonic Path—these eight words carried weight enough to crush anyone. Chen Ji seemed to watch his carefully built reputation crumble in that moment, all fellow disciples who trusted him and elders with high hopes for him now seeing him as a traitor. More terrifyingly, what would Su Qingyao think?

dialogue.content: "Rest assured, I won't let you sacrifice in vain." Mo Xiansheng seemed to read his concerns, "Your father is trapped in Kunlun Ruins, which is filled with ancient formations. Only the secret techniques of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path can open the entrance. Without their help, you'll never see him. And the public alliance is your proof of loyalty to win over the Holy Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Countless thoughts clashed violently in his Mental Sea: if he agreed, he would bear the name of traitor, Su Qingyao's trust destroyed, his years of careful planning ruined; but if he refused, his father would be trapped in the ruins forever, and what did the warning "do not trust the Tianji Record" mean? He made a note—another mystery to investigate later.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's conditions were laid out before Chen Ji, and he had to make a choice.

choices.text: Endure—pretend to agree while secretly seeking a solution
choices.description: First agree to stabilize Mo Xiansheng, then use these three months to find an alternative. His father's life must be saved, but that doesn't mean following the other party's script.
choices.visible_reward: Gain three months of buffer time
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng might see through your delaying tactics

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while, then finally nodded slowly: "Three months... I need time to plan." His tone was calm, as if discussing an ordinary transaction. Mo Xiansheng let out a meaningful chuckle: "As expected, I did not misjudge you. Three months from today, at the East Sea shore, I await your 'performance.'"

choices.text: Test—ask more about the truth of the Tianji Record
choices.description: The letter says not to trust the Tianji Record, there must be something hidden here. Before making the final decision, he must understand the relationship between Mo Xiansheng and the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Expose your suspicion of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may raise the price because of this

text.content: Chen Ji's words shifted abruptly, his gaze sharp as a blade: "The letter says the Tianji Record is not Father's possession, so what exactly is it? And who are you?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, then after a long pause said: "You're quite perceptive. That matter waits until after you complete the transaction—now, knowing too much brings you no good." His evasion only confirmed Chen Ji's suspicions.

choices.text: Compromise—accept the conditions but demand more leverage
choices.description: Since he must become a traitor, this deal must be worth more than its weight in gold. Besides saving his father, he must fight for more benefits for himself.
choices.visible_cost: Completely stand against the righteous path
choices.visible_reward: Gain more promises from Mo Xiansheng
choices.risk_hint: An appetite too big might anger the other party

text.content: A cold smirk curled at Chen Ji's lips: "I can agree to your conditions, but I have additional demands—after saving my father, you must reveal all the secrets of the Tianji Record to me. Additionally, I need long-term usage rights to the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path's 'Demonic Path Mist.'" Mo Xiansheng examined him for a long while before finally nodding: "Bold indeed. I agree."

Just then, Ye Qing's voice came from behind: "Chen Ji, Su Qingyao has sent a message saying there's an urgent matter to discuss, seemingly related to the Sect Competition three days from now." Chen Ji's heart tightened—Su Qingyao was his most important piece, but also the most dangerous variable. If she sensed anything at this time...

dialogue.content: Ye Qing walked close to his side, lowering her voice: "Su Qingyao is no ordinary person. If you get too close to her, you'll inevitably slip up. If Mo Xiansheng's deal succeeds, she will be the first to become your enemy." Her tone carried a warning, yet also hidden concern, "Are you certain you want to walk this path?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's warning plunged Chen Ji into a new dilemma—how to find balance between his father and his love?

choices.text: Reassure Ye Qing, promise not to implicate her
choices.description: Ye Qing is his most reliable ally at present, he cannot let her develop cold feet. At the same time hint that he has other backup plans, no need to worry about Su Qingyao.
choices.visible_cost: Need to give her an answer
choices.visible_reward: Stabilize the alliance with Ye Qing

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to face Ye Qing directly, his gaze warm yet firm: "Rest assured, I walk this path alone and will not implicate the Holy Sect. As for Su Qingyao..." He paused, a hint of playfulness appearing at the corner of his lips, "She might become my greatest enemy, or perhaps the most unexpected variable. But regardless, I will not let anyone fall into danger because of me."

choices.text: Remind her to watch Su Qingyao's movements
choices.description: Since Ye Qing raised the warning, take the opportunity to have her monitor Su Qingyao. Double-layered layout, mutually supporting each other.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a more comprehensive intelligence network
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might have her own calculations

dialogue.content: Chen Ji nodded slightly: "In that case, I'll trouble the Saintess to pay close attention to Su Qingyao's movements. If she shows any unusual behavior, inform me immediately." Ye Qing took the communication Talisman Paper, a meaningful smile curling at her lips: "Are you using me, or trusting me?" Chen Ji said calmly: "Is there a difference? We are, after all, a cooperative relationship where each takes what they need."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul coalesced again, this time his voice carrying a hint of impatience: "Boy, this old man's patience is limited. Three days, I give you three days to consider. If there's still no answer after three days, the news that Chen Tianming is alive will spread throughout the entire cultivation world. Then..." He let out a sinister laugh, "Do you think those hypocritical righteous ones will spare him?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his head abruptly, a flash of killing intent in his eyes, but he forcibly suppressed it. Remember this, he silently vowed. Mo Xiansheng's debt, he would repay tenfold someday. But at this moment, his father's life outweighed everything. He drew a deep breath, his voice returning to its usual calm: "Three days... that's enough."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure slowly faded, leaving behind words before departing: "By the way, that phrase on the letter 'do not trust the Tianji Record'... you'd better take it to heart. The 'future' it shows may not be your true future." Where his voice fell, silence reigned in the Mental Sea. Chen Ji gripped the blood-stained letter, his knuckles white. Father's warning, Mo Xiansheng's coercion, the secrets of the Tianji Record—three days, he had to find that single path of survival in this tangled mess.

Night wind swept across the cliff, dispersing the last traces of Mo Xiansheng's aura. Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, gazing into the east—that was the direction where Su Qingyao was, where the righteous path's center lay that he had been plotting in for years. Three days, enough for him to make a decision, and enough for everything to become irreversible. "Father..." he murmured softly, his voice scattered by the wind, "Please wait for me three more days."
